title: Headless Server Product Boundary
summary: Define a bounded headless service surface around explicit identities, workspaces, immutable candidate data, and read-only retrieval.
productOutcome: A service consumer can authenticate, address an authorized workspace, inspect a candidate, and request bounded evidence with stable provenance.

responsibilities.observer: Observe local source and submit explicit protocol messages.
responsibilities.server: Authenticate service requests, authorize workspace access, persist service state, and enforce request limits.

security: Authorize every workspace operation for the requesting identity.
Validate request shape, size, and enum values before expensive work.
Keep tenant and workspace data isolated.
Do not expose filesystem paths, credentials, or parser diagnostics in external errors.
storage: Keep candidate and active identities immutable.
Use explicit activation and rollback operations.
Retain history according to declared bounds and preserve references still in use.
Do not use a missing record as authority to recreate or trust data.

serviceLimits.concurrency: Bounded admission with explicit overload responses.
serviceLimits.response: Bounded evidence and stable typed errors.

nonGoals: No implicit project enrollment or publication.
No claim of distributed availability or throughput without dedicated measurement.
